newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADT raised by Lehman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADT raised by Lehman.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Jeffrey Kessler said he raised ADT Ltd to a buy rating from outperform following the collapse of its planned acquisition by Republic Industries Inc.
-- He said ADT is likely to strengthen its position and market share, in part through acquisitions.
-- He said new products and services could add as many as 100,000 new accounts in 1997.
-- He expects another potential suitor to emerge in the next two to three years.
-- Kessler said annual recurring revenue estimate of $890 million is very conservative.
